items.quote: And the field of Ephron which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, and the cave which was therein, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all the borders round about, were made sure Unto Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city.
items.claim: Abraham received the field of Ephron including its cave and trees as a possession at Machpelah, confirmed before the children of Heth and all who entered the city gate
items.object: the field of Ephron, the cave, all the trees
items.mechanism: in the presence of the children of Heth, before all that went in at the gate of his city
